name: Storybook Maker
original_description:
Write a short story in the chat with ChatGPT, a few pages with characters of your own, then illustrate it one page at a time: say what happens on the page, who the characters are and the style, soft watercolor, bold flat colors or colored pencil. From the second page on, the first page is passed as a reference so the characters and the style stay the same. You get one illustrated page per run, landscape, portrait or square.

The text of the story stays in the chat, not on the pictures, so you can set it under each page in the layout you like.

ChatGPT tells you what each page needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The pages open in the chat and stay in your library.

For parents, grandparents and teachers making a story of their own, for bedtime, a gift or a class project.

Limitations: one illustrated page per run, without the story text on it; original characters only, not characters or brands owned by others. It does not print or bind the book. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
